newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Largest capitalisation firms lift Moroccan bourse.
newsitem.headline: Largest capitalisation firms lift Moroccan bourse.

text.p: The Moroccan stock exchange ended its two-hour session higher 0.45 percent pulled up by largest capitalisation companies, including ONA Group and its subsidiaries, a bourse official said.
The all-share index closed at 442.94 points, up from 440.95 points on the previous session.

"The market pursues its upward trend pushed by the blue-chip firms...Traded stocks gained between one and 20 dirhams in one session," a broker said. ONA, Morocco's largest private group, which has stakes in more than 100 firms, closed at 506 dirhams, up from 505 dirhams on Wednesday.

Its subsidiary sugar refinery Cosumar, jumped 20 dirhams to close at 755 dirhams. Societe Nationale d'Investissent, the country's second largest conglomerate, was traded at 542 dirhams, up from 530 dirhams.
Wafabank, a liquid stock that merged with Spanish bank Uniban, gained five dirhams to close at 555 dirhams.
Uniban was not traded on Thursday while it closed at 113 dirhams on Wednesday. Traded volume on the official market was 26.4 million dirhams, down from 34.6 million on Wednesday.
